why: An outside gust wrecks the umbrella; it is pushed back and survives.
The body senses the danger before it can be explained.
A spoken name arrives and changes the room.
A moving drop is stopped and held as it is.
Two move one load by adjusting to each other.
The way is made leap after leap.
Scarcity forces the choice of what is truly needed.
Keeping to the truth knowingly costs one's own credit.
An unmarked surface where nothing has been written.
Shared joy in the middle of a failed dinner.
Light returns and shows where one stands.
After night turns to morning the same thing reads differently.
Something is given and something received between both sides.
The content exists but is not yet known.
Completion happens inside, unseen from outside.
The easy road no longer leads where one meant to go.
Small acts done long before ripen into a result.
One sees oneself among other people as in a mirror.
A sharp stop at the threshold just as the move is made.
Rising movement is stopped and held in view under ice.
Two share one rhythm that neither forced.
Resistance gives way to bodily force.
Hail from outside knocks down what was set up.
Honesty is kept and the price is paid knowingly.
A bare wall with no mark yet.
Shared lightness in the middle of a chore.
One always keeps watch while the others feed.
The new water follows a course handed down by the old.
A small flame reveals only a small circle.
A closed vessel whose contents and origin are not yet known.
Under cover it grows by itself until ready.
A road made only by people walking it.
Long earlier work shows as a result at its own time.
One sees oneself through another person.
A sharp sting at the edge stops the step before harm.
Flowing water is stopped and held in place.
Care prepares room for new fragile life.
What stands still spoils while what moves stays good.
An outside force breaks the work and shows what is lost.
One person alone takes the side on record and bears it.
An empty page with nothing written yet.
What is carried on and passed along is what bears fruit.
A guard that shuts out most and lets a few through.
A thing carried on from home to home.
Light reveals what was there all along.
Under strain the runner yields but does not break off.
A hidden movement under the surface is felt before it is seen.
A single call arrives and everyone responds.
What was planted long ago now gives its result.
One learns about oneself through another's mouth.
The rushed move is halted just before it is made.
Growth is limited to what the constraint allows.
Fragile life given a new place slowly begins to grow.
What is left unused loses its strength.
The plan is cancelled from outside at the last moment.
Sunlight simply shines and shows everything.
A turn after which the same things face the other way.
An uncounted attention is given from one person to another.
Open enough to see, guarded enough not to let all in.
Something inherited is carried on with one's own change.
A small light reveals something that was there all along.
It bends under the force and does not break.
Something is sensed before it can be named.
Speaking the thing aloud changes what it is.
A moving thing stops and is held between while all else goes on.
Two move together in an unchanging shared rhythm.
Resistance calls out a bodily strength already there.
There is not enough for both, and the lack presses.
A small beginner is given room rather than forced.
A thing saved and never used gives nothing.
A shared lightening as the whole street opens up.
When daylight comes the same thing looks different.
One turn and the same street is seen in a new way.
A loan returns with an uncounted gift on top.
Something is there but does not show itself yet.
Shut away and unwatched, it grew on its own inside.
The rhythm of the road is found only by walking.
